verdict.rationale: Meltano's docs describe catalog generation and stream/property selection for extraction (meltano-docs-10, meltano-docs-19, meltano-docs-20, meltano-docs-30), but none of this evidence describes detecting upstream schema changes or letting engineers choose a propagation policy (e.g., auto-add columns, fail-fast, quarantine) versus silently breaking loads. Community discussion raises unresolved concerns about handling non-standard/nested schemas (meltano-comm-3) without confirming any schema-evolution policy mechanism. missing for 10: explicit schema-change detection mechanism, configurable propagation/failure policy, evidence of behavior on breaking upstream changes.
